spec.situation_desc: is asking about branch opening hours

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Sam speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi Sam, I’m Lucia Okonkwo. Could you tell me what time your High Street branch in Bristol opens on Saturdays?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Of course, Lucia. I’ll check the latest branch information for you. Just a moment, please.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks for waiting. The information I can see says the branch is open on Saturdays from nine until one.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: That’s helpful. Is that definitely the opening time for this coming Saturday?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can’t confirm the latest hours for a particular date from the information in front of me, so I don’t want to guess.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Okay. What’s the best way to check?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll check with the branch team and get back to you by 3 pm today with the hours they’ve confirmed for this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: That would be great, thank you.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re welcome. I’ll use the contact details you’ve already provided to us to follow up. Is that all right?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Just to recap, the general information I’ve found is nine till one on Saturdays, and I’ll confirm this coming Saturday’s hours with the branch team and contact you by 3 pm today. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, it does. Thanks for checking.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re very welcome, Lucia. Thanks for calling Thistle Bank, and enjoy the rest of your day.
